title: Cloud Country Charters Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Cloud Country Charters operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Cloud Country Charters installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 65158 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where founding docs monitoring, charter logistics redundancy, or member onboarding maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cloud Country Charters Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cloud Country Charters: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cloud Country Charters — charters for cloud-first political communities.

Phase 1 — Prove (founding docs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (charter logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (member onboarding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dispute systems): charter hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and network states-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
